mapper.select: SELECT /*+ JOIN_PREFIX(d) INDEX(d idx_w18_owned_receipt_read) */ d.id AS installationId,d.target_draft_id AS targetDraftId,d.target_revision AS targetRevision, u.committed_at AS installedAt,CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(r.version_id)<=512 THEN r.version_id ELSE NULL END AS versionId,r.content_hash AS contentHash,r.terms_hash AS termsHash, s.payload_hash AS scopePayloadHash FROM content_draft t JOIN ums_member m ON m.id=t.owner_member_id AND m.status=1 AND m.del_flag=0 JOIN w18_module_owned_draft d ON d.target_draft_id=t.id AND d.buyer_kind='INDIVIDUAL' AND d.buyer_id=t.owner_member_id JOIN w18_module_install_reservation r ON r.reservation_key=d.reservation_key AND r.buyer_kind=d.buyer_kind AND r.buyer_id=d.buyer_id AND r.draft_id=d.target_draft_id AND r.draft_revision=d.target_revision AND r.actor_id=d.installed_by AND r.state='CONSUMED' JOIN w18_module_install_usage u ON u.owned_draft_id=d.id AND u.reservation_key=d.reservation_key AND u.committed_at=d.installed_at AND u.committed_at=r.terminal_at LEFT JOIN w18_content_draft_install_scope s ON s.draft_id=d.target_draft_id AND s.draft_version=d.target_revision AND s.owner_member_id=d.buyer_id WHERE t.id=#{draftId} AND t.owner_member_id=#{actor} AND t.status='DRAFT' AND t.business_type IN ('TOPIC','ACTIVITY') AND d.buyer_id=#{actor} AND d.installed_by=#{actor} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM w18_module_draft_component c WHERE c.draft_id=d.id AND c.local_key='template' AND c.component_kind='TEXT_TEMPLATE' AND c.schema_version=1) ORDER BY d.installed_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT 51
